assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries.
The condition is coded as R55.
The condition is coded as I25.10.
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of these collapse events.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic periods.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The monitoring is required to address the clinical indication of syncope in the context of the patient's cardiac history.
